sentences.en: Would you mind if I asked you some questions?
sentences.zh: 您介意我问您几个问题吗？

sentences.en: We're doing a survey on transport
sentences.zh: 我们正在开展一项关于交通方式的调查。

sentences.en: MAN: First of all, can l take your name?
sentences.zh: MAN: 首先，可以告诉我您的姓名吗？

sentences.en: And could have your date of birth - just the year will do, actually
sentences.zh: 另外，能否告知您的出生年份——只需年份即可。

sentences.en: MAN: So next your postcode, please
sentences.zh: MAN: 接下来，请告诉我您的邮政编码。

sentences.en: SADIE: No it's actually in Harborne: Wells isn't far from there, though
sentences.zh: SADIE: 不是，实际上是在哈伯恩（Harborne）；不过韦尔斯离那里不远。

sentences.en: MAN: I really like that area
sentences.zh: MAN: 我真的很喜欢那个地区。

sentences.en: My grandmother lived there when I was a kid
sentences.zh: 我小时候，我祖母就住在那里。
SADIE: 是的，那里确实不错。

sentences.en: MAN: Right, so now I want to ask you some questions about how you travelled here today
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，接下来我想问问您今天来这里的交通方式。
您今天使用了公共交通工具吗？

sentences.en: It's the 24th of April, isn't it?
And what was the reason for your trip today?
sentences.zh: 那么，您今天出行的主要原因是什么呢？

sentences.en: I can see you've got some shopping with you
sentences.zh: 我看到您带了一些购物袋。

sentences.en: I did some shopping but the main reason came here was to go to the dentist
sentences.zh: 我确实买了些东西，但今天来这儿主要是去看牙医。

sentences.en: SADIE: No, it was just a check-up
sentences.zh: SADIE: 没有，只是常规检查。

sentences.en: Do you normally travel by bus into the city centre?
sentences.zh: 您通常乘公交车去市中心吗？

sentences.en: I stopped driving in ages ago because parking was so difficult to find and it costs so much
sentences.zh: 我很久以前就不再开车了，因为很难找到停车位，而且停车费用太高。

sentences.en: SADIE: The bus is much more convenient too
sentences.zh: SADIE: 公交车也方便得多。

sentences.en: So where did you start your journey?
sentences.zh: 那么，您的行程是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: SADIE: At the bus stop on Claxby Street
sentences.zh: SADIE: 从克拉克斯比街（Claxby Street）的公交站。

sentences.en: MAN: And how satisfied with the service are you?
sentences.zh: MAN: 您对这项服务的满意程度如何？

sentences.en: SADIE: Well, as I said, it's very convenient and quick when it's on time, but this morning it was late
sentences.zh: SADIE: 嗯，正如我之前所说，如果准点的话，公交车确实非常方便快捷，但今天早上它晚点了。
只晚了大约10分钟，但毕竟还是有影响。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, I understand that's annoying
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，我理解这确实令人烦恼。

sentences.en: Do you have any comments about that?

I suppose mainly use the bus during the day, but any time I've been in town in the evening - for dinner or at the cinema - I've noticed you have to wait a long time for a - bus - there aren't that many
sentences.zh: 我想我主要是在白天乘坐公交车，但任何一次晚上在城里——比如吃饭或看电影——我都注意到等公交车要花很长时间，因为班次并不多。

sentences.en: So now I'd like to ask you about your car use
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向您了解一下您使用汽车的情况。

sentences.en: SADIE: Well, I have got a car but I don't use it that often
sentences.zh: SADIE: 嗯，我确实有一辆车，但并不经常使用。

sentences.en: Mainly just to go to the supermarket
My husband uses it at the weekends to go to the golf club
sentences.zh: 我丈夫周末会开车去高尔夫俱乐部。

sentences.en: MAN: And what about a bicycle?
SADIE: I don't actually have one at the moment
sentences.zh: SADIE: 目前我实际上并没有自行车。

sentences.en: MAN: What about the city bikes you can rent?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那您用过市里可租用的公共自行车吗？

sentences.en: SADIE: No - I'm not keen on cycling there because of all the pollution
sentences.zh: SADIE: 不会——我不太愿意在那里骑车，因为污染太严重了。

sentences.en: But would like to get a bike - it would be it good to use it to get to work
sentences.zh: 但我倒是想买一辆自行车——骑车上班会很不错。

sentences.en: MAN: So why haven't you got one now?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那您现在为什么还没有呢？

sentences.en: SADIE: Well, I live in a flat - on the second floor and it doesn't have any storage - so we'd have to leave it in the hall outside the flat
sentences.zh: SADIE: 嗯，我住在一套公寓里——在二楼，而且公寓内没有储物空间——所以我们只能把自行车放在公寓门外的走廊上。
